name: Pigment Printing Emulsion
summary: Pigment emulsion for bright, durable prints on cotton and blended knitwear.
description: A ready-to-use pigment emulsion for textile printing, giving even colour and good fastness when used with the right binder and curing conditions.
We help you choose shade, dosage and curing parameters for your fabric before you order.

name: Textile Softener
summary: Finishing softener for a soft, smooth hand feel on knitted fabrics.
description: A finishing softener applied by padding or exhaust to give knitwear a soft, smooth hand feel.
Application advice covers bath pH, dosage and compatibility with your other finishing chemicals.

name: Waterproofing Coating
summary: Waterproofing coating for roofs, terraces and wet areas.
description: A waterproofing coating for roofs, terraces, bathrooms and other wet areas.
Our team advises on surface preparation, coverage and curing, and supports applicators on site.

name: Tile Adhesive
summary: Polymer-modified tile adhesive for floors and walls.
description: A cement-based, polymer-modified adhesive for fixing ceramic and vitrified tiles on floors and walls.
We help contractors choose the right grade for the tile and substrate.

name: Monoethylene Glycol (MEG)
summary: Monoethylene glycol for polyester, coolants and industrial processes.
description: Monoethylene glycol is a clear, colourless glycol used as a raw material and process chemical across industry.
Supplied as genuine principal product from stock you can plan production around.

name: Diethylene Glycol (DEG)
summary: Diethylene glycol for resins, plasticisers and industrial applications.
description: Diethylene glycol is used as a raw material for resins and plasticisers and as a humectant and solvent in industry.
Supplied as genuine principal product with dependable stock.
